name: locoland-lgc
description: Language support, IntelliSense and static checks for Locoland .lgc logic scripts.

lgc.format.indentStyle.description: Use the active editor indentation settings, spaces, or tab characters.

lgc.format.indentSize.description: Spaces per indentation level. Use 0 to follow the editor tab size.

lgc.format.braceStyle.description: Place opening braces on the same line as the declaration or control statement, or on the following line.

lgc.format.spaceBeforeParens.description: Spacing before parentheses: only control keywords, every parenthesis, or none.

lgc.format.spaceInsideBrackets.description: Insert spaces immediately inside array brackets.

lgc.format.spaceAroundOperators.description: Insert spaces around binary and assignment operators.

lgc.format.spaceBeforeColon.description: Insert a space before the colon in ternary expressions.

lgc.format.spaceAfterColon.description: Insert a space after the colon in ternary expressions.

lgc.format.blankLinesBetweenFunctions.description: Number of blank lines between top-level braced declarations.

lgc.format.preserveBlankLines.description: Preserve blank lines already present in the source, up to maxBlankLines.

lgc.format.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines preserved from the source.

lgc.format.indentCaseLabels.description: Indent case and default labels one level inside switch blocks.

lgc.format.keepEmptyBlocksSingleLine.description: Keep empty blocks as {} instead of expanding them onto multiple lines.

lgc.format.insertFinalNewline.description: Ensure formatted documents end with a newline.

lgc.analysis.checkFunctionArity.description: Report calls with too few or too many arguments when the signature is known.

lgc.analysis.checkArgumentTypes.description: Check known int/string function parameter types when the expression type can be inferred safely.

lgc.analysis.checkAssignments.description: Check assignments to explicitly typed local variables when both sides have known types.

lgc.analysis.strictUnknownFunctions.description: Report function calls that are not found in the engine API, bundled helper catalog or workspace scripts.

lgc.analysis.severity.description: Default severity used by static-analysis diagnostics.

lgc.analysis.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of .lgc files indexed from the current workspace.
